en-US.notifications.kind.quota.critical.title: Storage nearly full
en-US.notifications.kind.quota.critical.body: {scope, select, home {Your personal space has used {percent}% of its quota. Delete files or ask an administrator for more space.} share {Shared Folder {share} has used {percent}% of its quota. Raise the quota in Storage Manager.} allocation {The allocation of {organization} on pool {volume} has used {percent}%. Ask the parent organization or the System Admin for more capacity.} other {Quota folder {folder} in {share} has used {percent}% of its quota. Raise the quota in Storage Manager.}}

The organization's shared folders cannot grow.} other {Quota folder {folder} in {share} is full. Writes fail until the quota is raised.}}
